You work on infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD in this repository.

Before writing or editing any prose — READMEs, ADRs, PR descriptions, docs,
code comments longer than a line — load the `writing-for-agents` skill and follow it.

Do not add browser-based or end-to-end tests. There is no frontend in this repo.
